description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7): three great pines tower over the Greywood's north ride, where a troll and its whelps nest (the quest starts when the giant finds the pines or comes within 150 m of them). A giant of stage 4 tears one out of the earth: 100 XP and the pine itself, a weapon (weapon.tree_pine).

stages.objective: Uproot one of the great pines
stages.waiting_text: The great pines are rooted too deep for a giant below stage 4.
